message:
Not every shutter has slats.

Solid panel shutters are timber panels that open and close like internal doors — recessed detailing, visible hinges, ring pulls. When they’re shut, you get a much more complete cover over the glass than a louvred plantation shutter.

They suit period sash windows, street-facing bedrooms and anyone who wants a darker room at night. The trade-off: you lose that all-day tilt of the louvres. Fold them back when you want the window clear.

We’ve written a plain 2026 guide covering:

• Solid panels vs louvres (when each wins)
• Sash windows, bedrooms and home offices
• Draughts and noise — honest limits
• What we check on a Leicestershire survey

Read it here: https://shutter-envy.co.uk/solid-panel-shutters-uk-buyers-guide/
